description: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead-acid storage batteries for industrial and automotive applications in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Lead Acid Batteries and Allied Products; and New Energy Business. The company provides new energy business related products; installation, commissioning, and maintenance services; and industrial chargers, integrated power systems, electric charging solutions, and battery energy storage systems, as well as lithium-based home UPS systems and hybrid inverter platforms for residential and small commercial applications. It also develops, manufactures, and sells energy storage and management products, solutions, and technologies related to lithium cells, advanced cell chemistries, battery packs, and components. The company sells its batteries under the Amaron, PowerZone, Power Stack, AmaronVolt, Amaron Brute, Amaron Sleek, ELITO, and Quanta brands. The company supplies its batteries to various customer groups, such as telecom, railways, solar, motive, power control, international operations, defence, and UPS; and automobile original equipment manufacturers, replacement markets, and private label customers. The company was formerly known as Amara Raja Batteries Limited and changed its name to Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited in September 2023. Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
